other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must have completed a pilgrimage to the Sita Temple and Ashoka Vatika in Sri Lanka and the Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia.
The applicant must not be an income taxpayer.
Each individual is eligible to receive financial assistance only once in their lifetime.
Application must be made within 60 days of completing the journey.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expenses up to ₹30,000 per eligible pilgrim.
